info.title: Blink Home Monitor API
info.description:
Official Blink cloud service API endpoints for home security cameras and sync modules. This API provides comprehensive access to Blink camera systems including authentication, device management, live streaming, video clips, and local storage operations.

This specification was created from the documentation at https://github.com/MattTW/BlinkMonitorProtocol (commit 5e2e78ec70d1e1870cd192bf26358d246e148e23, dated 2025-07-30) and cross-referenced with the blinkpy library implementation.

post.description: Authenticate with Blink servers using email and password. Returns authentication token and account information. May trigger 2FA verification for new clients.

reauth.description: Whether this is a re-authentication request

400.description: Invalid credentials or missing required fields

post.description: Verify the PIN code sent via email or SMS for two-factor authentication. Required for new clients or when explicitly requested.
Invalidate the current authentication token and logout from Blink servers.

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive account information including networks, sync modules, cameras, and system status. This is typically the first call after authentication.
Retrieve information about all networks associated with the authenticated account. This endpoint is deprecated in favor of the homescreen endpoint.

post.description: Arm the security system for the specified network. This enables motion detection and recording for all cameras in the network.
Disarm the security system for the specified network. This disables motion detection and recording for all cameras in the network.

get.description: Poll the status of an asynchronous command. Commands like arm/disarm, thumbnail capture, and video recording are asynchronous and require polling to determine completion.

parameters.name: command_id
parameters.description: Command identifier returned from initial command request

post.description: Enable motion detection for the specified camera. When enabled, the camera will detect motion and trigger recordings based on system arm state.
Disable motion detection for the specified camera. When disabled, the camera will not detect motion or trigger recordings regardless of system arm state.
Request the camera to capture a new thumbnail image. This is an asynchronous operation that returns a command ID for status polling.
Request the camera to record a new video clip. This is an asynchronous operation that returns a command ID for status polling.

200.description: Video clip capture command initiated successfully

post.description: Request a live video stream from the camera. Returns server information and RTSP stream URL for real-time viewing.

intent.description: Intent for the live view request

motion_event_start_time.description: Motion event start time (empty string for immediate)

get.description: Retrieve video clips that have been created or modified since the specified timestamp. Supports pagination for large result sets.
Download the actual video file for a clip. The filename is typically obtained from the media field of a VideoClip object.
Download the thumbnail image for a video clip. The filename is typically obtained from the thumbnail field of a VideoClip object.

get.summary: Get camera thumbnail image (direct media URL)
get.description: Retrieve the current thumbnail image directly from the camera. This URL format is used for direct media access with timestamp and extension parameters.
Retrieve all schedules/programs defined for the specified network. Schedules allow automatic arm/disarm operations based on time and day of week.

post.description: Enable a specific schedule/program for the network.
Disable a specific schedule/program for the network.

get.description: Retrieve the current notification settings for the account.

post.description: Update notification settings for the account.
Temporarily disable notifications for a specific camera for a specified duration.

get.description: Determine if a new version of the official client is available. This call does not require authentication.
Get valid region information for a specific locale. Authentication is not required.

get.summary: Get camera thumbnail image (production media URL)
get.description: Retrieve the JPEG thumbnail picture of a camera. The URL path is specified in the thumbnail attribute of the camera from the homescreen call.
Retrieve the current configuration settings for a specific camera.

post.description: Update configuration settings for a specific camera (primarily for Catalina cameras).

get.description: Retrieve current sensor readings from the camera including battery, temperature, and signal strength.

new_account.description: Whether this is a new account

join_available.description: Whether joining the stream is available

server.description: RTSP server URL for live stream

new_command.description: Whether this is a new command
